name: Komori Megumi
source:
A first-year student and member of the basketball team. She has a Shih Tzu breed dog named Allion (nicknamed A-kun) and brought it together with her to the training camp. In difficult times, she works as a pair with [url=/c592]Kaneda[/url]. Her family manages a Japanese-style confectionery store.

[From Shiori-chan's review]
